BiblicalUsage: Piyd is misfortune, ruin, destruction falling on a man. Job says he did not rejoice at the destruction of him who hated him in Job 31:29, and that a man cries out in his destruction in Job 30:24. Proverbs 24:22 warns that calamity shall rise suddenly on the rebellious.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe another man's ruin is never a cause for joy, even when he hated me.
